exactPrompt: Create exactly one 1254×1254 RGB PNG provider-source raster for the tier F (Common) rarity-frame layer. Use the supplied Option C comparison only as visual authority and the supplied geometry guide as registration authority; do not crop, trace, or reuse source pixels. Preserve the shared point-up hexagonal geometry and exact registration after the pipeline's full-canvas resize to 1024×1024. Build a weathered iron frame with a narrow undecorated rim, hammered wear, and nearly hidden rivets. Include one small integrated top-center medallion bearing only the uppercase letter F. Keep the intended central aperture and the entire area outside the hard frame boundary as the perfectly uniform chroma field; the frame must form a substantial continuous rim along all six sides and remain legible at 96 pixels after normalization. Render the asset on a perfectly uniform opaque #00FF00 matte with no baked checkerboard. The matte field must contain no simulated transparency, shadows, texture, gradient, color variation, or other marks. Use no green-colored material, green reflections, green oxidation, or green patina anywhere in the frame. Do not add a cast shadow, ambient-occlusion halo, or dark fringe in the central aperture or outside the hard frame boundary; the chroma field must meet every asset edge cleanly. The pipeline will remove the source matte, resize the raster, and apply the fixed rarity-frame role mask. No skill icon, emblem, backing, scenery, glow, or any other symbol, number, word, label, or text. Output only this isolated provider-source raster.
